Why the box and not a dev: the card asks to retire protocol machinery that, since it was filed, became the Tier S landing mechanism for `.claude/**` (Prime Directive #14; the queue guard reads the `## Contract review` record in the merge group). The maintainer's 2026-09-18 word withdrew the 「AI cannot self-review」 rule — and in-seat review at tier is now the design — but which of the remaining parts go (the gate label, the `--pair` pre-check, the double-carrier discipline, the checker's C4 / C6 / C7 rows, the reference) is gate strength, a maintainer-floor item. The 四棱 block and the 维护者速读 are on the body (options A / B / C; the seat recommends B: retire the label, `--pair`, the double-carrier discipline and the independence pair; keep the single record as the Tier S landing record; extract `readClause2Line`).

Premise re-read on `origin/main` `1c16889a61`: `scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs` is 10,333 lines (the card measured 9,132) and appears in no workflow under `.github/workflows/` (0 files; its `readClause2Line` export is what the two CI gates import); `needs:contract-review` is still hung and cleared by seats; `references/contract-review.md` is 60 lines; `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` binds the record to the current head (:290). ⛔ No dev dispatched; assignee untouched.

**Governing text:** the maintainer's 2026-09-18 words quoted on this card, verbatim 「不需要 AI 不能自审契约改动 这种」 and 「同意你的建议」; 2026-09-21 「我们系统开发了太多无用的门禁,反而在浪费时间」 (ruling #202, record 5753591106); `AGENTS.md` Prime Directive #14 and `:276-292` (Tier S lands on a contract-tier review record; the queue guard reads it); ruling #208 R5 (the at-tier review is owed by the face a diff touches).

**Ruled (B): three layers become one.** RETIRED — the `needs:contract-review` gate label and its hang/clear discipline (双载体); the `--pair` landing pre-check and `check-clause2-carriers.mjs`'s gate role (rows C4 independence pair, C6 review-of-record, C7 `Served-tier:` as landing conditions); the independence pair as a REQUIREMENT (`Implemented-by:` / `Reviewed-by:` stay as record lines; SELF-REVIEW is no longer a verdict); the carrier-discipline and downgrade-fuse sections of `references/contract-review.md`, and the SKILL.md 〈入队与落地〉 clause-② gate bullets that name them. KEPT — exactly one `## Contract review` record per governed (Tier S) PR, on the PR thread, naming the current head with `Served-tier:` — the record `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs:288-290` reads to release `.claude/**` in the merge group; the `Clause-②: yes | no` declaration line and `readClause2Line`, extracted into a small module (~40 lines) that `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` and `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` import, so two CI gates stop depending on a 10,333-line file; `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` in `dispatch-gates.mjs` for its path-mandate role. The queue guard's label-refusal leg (`:454`, exit 6) goes with the label. ⛔ Not A: the one record stays — it is the only audit trace left for governed text now that the governed-merge audit is retired.

**Execution order (Tier H — `.claude/**` and `AGENTS.md`; the maintainer merges):** ① extract `readClause2Line`; prove the four CI workflows (`lint.yml`, `pr-automation.yml`, `cut-rc.yml`, `release.yml`) green on the extracted module. ② remove the rule text, `--pair`, the double-carrier discipline and the independence-pair requirement from `SKILL.md` / `contract-review.md` / `core-rules.md` / `platform-readings.md` in one PR, the line ratchet paid by deletion. ③ last, the label. The `needs:contract-review` occurrence in `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts` is docblock PROSE at `:102` (「Registering a code widens this face and is therefore a Clause-② change (`needs:contract-review`)」), ⛔ not a ledger row and not a published code — ruled here: the same PR rewrites that sentence without the label name (the Clause-② statement stays), no spec-lane card. Then `ensure-pm-labels.sh` and each script that names the label (`check-half-states`, `check-governed-queue-guard`, `check-widening-tells`, `check-label-desc-cap`, `check-skill-line-ratchet`, `check-expected-skips`, `check-governed-merges`, `first-party-closure`) re-read for what it does with it. `check-clause2-carriers.mjs` itself may be deleted once nothing but the extracted module is imported.

**State in this stroke:** `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; `domain:skills` stays; `priority:*` is the skills seat's first-touch grading (the card carries none).
